summary: C19 adds explainable per-event interactions, explicit-policy per-sensor rate signals referencing committed C18 records, and separate health findings from validated durable C15 spool gaps. The existing project-segments CLI derives typed outcomes and reproduces the same alerts after restart; missing/incomplete index coverage remains visible. No schema/API/UI/dependency changes or remote Actions claims.

commands.argv: $(go env GOROOT)/bin/gofmt -l cmd internal tests; test -z output
Podman 4.9.3 rootless; pinned Alpine digest and network-none memory cgroup check
python3 scripts/verify_ci_source.py on clean implementation commit

scope_limits: Only local process and filesystem behavior is proven; physical power loss, kernel/filesystem corruption and remote-runner behavior are not certified.
The index is O(records) memory bounded indirectly by the mandatory segment record/segment limits; no measured capacity claim is made (C28).
Deleting the lowest or highest present segment creates no internal ordinal gap and is indistinguishable from a short history; C23 must preserve an ordinal high-water mark.
Absence from the index never proves non-ingestion. C15 gaps, C23 retention and missing segments remain separate evidence.
Exact duplicate records are tolerated and counted for backward compatibility with stores projected before C18; they are not removed from disk.
Sequence collisions with different event IDs are not part of the identity conflict rule; C04/C07 validation and C05 authority remain responsible for sequence semantics.
No retention, alerting, trace viewer, authenticated ingest, published decoy surface, HTTP API or UI is added; C30 remains the clean-host workflow/restart/restore gate.
Browser regression ran on 127.0.0.1:4199 with a temporary Playwright config inside docs/evidence/C18 because canonical loopback ports were occupied; the same three browser tests passed.
future_card_note: C20 owns triage, C21 owns health presentation, and C22 owns user-facing segment tracing; C19 keeps these scopes unchanged.

local_clone_verification.binding: Temporary local snapshot of the final C18 source passed clean-clone setup, Go vet/race/discovery, event validation, the deduplicating index regressions and local runtime startup. It does not certify hosted Actions or product readiness.
